elements_selected.content: `docs/reader.html` (static, served from dist/ in capability builds) + `docs/reader-troubleshooting.md`. Reader-facing onboarding: what a passkey is (no crypto jargon), how to enrol, what to do on a new device, what to do if you lose your authenticator, what to do if the shim shows a signature-verify error (contact your wiki operator). Linked from shim error messages.
